temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help enthusiastically.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria has no specific prior belief stated about Cheryl's ability to manage this project; she sees Cheryl as currently under pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Cheryl's visible stress and acceptance of help lead Maria to believe Cheryl could use assistance and would welcome her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is overwhelmed with the project but is open to help; Maria can assist and is willing to do so.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and empathy, followed by willingness and helpfulness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing more confident. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase; the Team Leader welcomes the suggestion, and Cheryl thanks Maria and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl was previously overwhelmed but has improved with help and is gaining confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Cheryl's improved handling, growing confidence, and acceptance of leadership confirm to Maria that Cheryl is ready for a leadership role and appreciates the nomination.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, committed, and ready to lead the next phase; Maria's suggestion was appropriate and welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and the next phase of the project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria privately approaches Cheryl. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that suggesting Cheryl for leadership may have overstepped or made Cheryl feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Cheryl's response shows she did not feel pressured; she was surprised but values Maria's support and confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl appreciates Maria's support, and there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings; Maria's concern is alleviated.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initial worry or anxiety, then relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported, not pressured, and to maintain a positive working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private conversation, Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support. Maria proposes co-leading the project; Cheryl calls it a fantastic idea and says Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her support and that their relationship is secure; she wants to continue their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Cheryl's enthusiastic acceptance of co-leading and praise of Maria's guidance confirms mutual trust and strong teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can co-lead effectively, support each other, and make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects; Cheryl says she would love that, calls working with Maria wonderful, and says she is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has strengthened through successful projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Cheryl's eager agreement and enthusiasm confirm that their synergy is mutual and that future collaboration is desired.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong and fruitful; they can achieve more together and are likely to continue teaming up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
